call_summary: Caller Alex Bennett requested a Sunday 10 a.m. new-patient consultation; the agent created a demo profile, declined the Sunday request, and offered Monday September 14th at 9 a.m., which the caller accepted before the test bot ended the call. Core Sunday-handling behaviour was correct, with some minor phrasing, turn-taking, and dead-air issues.

findings.title: Explain Sunday unavailability as closed hours, not just 'no openings'
findings.quote: I checked the schedule for Sunday, but there are no openings that day.
findings.what_happened: The agent declined the Sunday request but framed it as a full schedule rather than the office being closed, leaving the impression Sunday slots could exist another week. Even after the caller directly asked if they are open Sundays, the answer was still 'does not have appointments available on Sundays' rather than a clear statement of office hours.
findings.why_it_matters: Callers may keep calling back or expect a future Sunday opening that will never exist, generating avoidable repeat calls and confusion.
findings.expected: State plainly that the practice is closed on Sundays and give the actual operating days/hours before offering weekday alternatives.

findings.title: Fix agent talking over the caller during name capture
findings.quote: Thanks, Alex. What is your last name?
findings.what_happened: The system event log records a barge-in at 0:43 where the agent cut off the caller mid-utterance after 4140ms of caller speech.
findings.why_it_matters: Talking over callers risks mis-capturing identifying details like names and frustrates patients.
findings.expected: Wait for end-of-speech before responding, and only barge in on clearly detected silence.

findings.title: Reduce dead air during profile creation
findings.quote: Let me get your demo patient profile set up. One moment while I take care of that.
findings.what_happened: Roughly 32 seconds elapsed between starting profile creation (1:02) and completion (1:34), filled only with a repeated 'please hold on just a moment' message.
findings.why_it_matters: Long silent or filler-only stretches on an automated line cause callers to assume the call has dropped and hang up.
findings.expected: Complete profile setup faster or collect the appointment details in parallel instead of stalling the caller.

findings.title: Do not assign an unverified date of birth to the patient record
findings.quote: Your demo patient profile is ready, and your date of birth is set as July 4, 2000 for this demo.
findings.what_happened: The agent populated the patient profile with a date of birth it invented, without ever asking the caller for it.
findings.why_it_matters: A fabricated DOB on a patient record breaks downstream identity verification and can cause chart mismatches or duplicate/incorrect records.
findings.expected: Ask the caller for their date of birth, or explicitly leave the field blank and flag it for staff completion.
